data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 旅途明信片
data.description: 她选出一张画着街景的明信片，准备写给老朋友，告诉对方自己最近过得很好。
data.promptProse: Inside a charming stationery boutique, Angelina inspects a scenic watercolor postcard selected from a rotating wire rack. Shelves of colored inks, wax seals, and textured letter paper line the background beneath cozy incandescent ceiling lamps.
data.animaCaption: Spinning the wire postcard carousel with a light flick of her fingers, she selects a vibrant city view to send to her friends.
